# clevercloud_cellar (Resource)

Manage [Cellar](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/cellar/) product.

See [Cellar product specification](https://www.clever.cloud/developers/doc/addons/cellar/).

## Import

Import this resource with its real ID, the value of its `id` attribute. The add-on ID (`addon_xxx`) is refused.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Cellar

### Optional

- `region` (String) Geographical region where the data will be stored
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags of the resource, either plain (`prod`) or key/value (`env:prod`). When unset, tags are not managed by Terraform: the ones set outside of it are left untouched and never show up in the state, imports included. Removing the attribute therefore keeps the current tags, set `tags = []` to remove them all

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) S3 compatible Cellar endpoint
- `id` (String) Generated unique identifier
- `key_id` (String) Key ID used to authenticate
- `key_secret` (String, Sensitive) Key secret used to authenticate
